video_description:
Project Blaze OS on Android 12L as a GSI for the Xiaomi 11T Pro — a quick flash, a cold boot, and a straight answer about what a GSI means for the rest of your phone.

This is the light version of a ROM review. One image, one flash, and the part that actually matters: how it behaves once your vendor layer is in the mix. Project Blaze on Android 12L is the base here, and only an ARM64 AB image is published for it.

📱 Device  : Xiaomi 11T Pro
🧩 ROM     : Project Blaze OS (GSI, phh-treble)
🤖 Android : 12L
👤 Credits : @ChonDoe

🎬 In This Clip
• Flashing the GSI over fastboot, start to finish.
• Cold boot and first setup.
• A look around the ROM, then the honest part about device-side behavior.
• The downloads, so you can run the same flash.

❓ Common Questions
• Do I have to wipe data? Yes, and it's step six for a reason — skipping it usually ends in a bootloop.
• Which image should I download? ARM64 AB. That's the only architecture published for this release.
• Is there a vanilla build? No. This release is GApps or slim.
• Do I need to be on a specific vendor? Not a specific one, but a recent vendor and kernel gives you far fewer hardware surprises.
• What about bugs? Nothing is listed inside the ROM. On the device side it depends on your vendor and kernel, so results differ per phone.

📦 Install Order
1. fastboot reboot fastboot
2. fastboot --disable-verity --disable-verification flash vbmeta
3. fastboot erase system
4. fastboot flash system
5. fastboot reboot recovery
6. Wipe data in Mi Recovery, then reboot
